neighbours.label: Statistical rate and proportion words over a population or total ('rates', 'percent', 'incidence', 'number of', 'almost N%'), vs the same topics described without a rate or share
fire: In the northern provinces, infant mortality rates fell during the last decade.
Surveys show that about 30 percent of adults never exercise at all.
Coal plants produce almost 40% of the country's electricity.
Doctors reported that dengue incidence doubled after the heavy rains.
Officials counted the total number of cases in each district.
Roughly one in five children in the region is underweight.
Unemployment rates among young men remain stubbornly high.
The share of renewable energy reached 25 percent last year.
quiet: In the northern provinces, the new clinics opened during the last decade.
Surveys show that many adults enjoy walking in the evening.
Coal plants in the country are old and need repair.
Doctors reported that the clinics were crowded after the heavy rains.
Officials visited the hospitals in each district by car.
Children in the region walk a long way to school.
Young men in the city often work at the docks.
The new wind farm was finished early last year.

predictions: Rate/share words reach 0.35-0.55; topic twins without a rate stay under 0.15.
notes: Card: peaks on ' rates', '%', ' percent', ' of' after a percent, ' incidence', ' almost' before a percentage, in environment/health statistics. Probe: 'death rates' 0.456, '40 percent of' 0.378, 'almost 20%' 0.474, 'Malaria incidence' 0.504, 'average number of fires' 0.419; 'death certificates' 0.016, 'huge amounts of carbon' 0.102; 'mostly on rent' leaked 0.301 (so vague share words also fire).
